answer: Admit newcomers through one narrow inlet guarded by a jetty permit system. Each applicant forges a passage token by finishing five micro-jobs before harbor masters, each job timestamped and co-signed. The applicant locks 300 POA for 60 days; one proven fraud slashes the bond and bars the forger for a year. Only 40 permits issue per epoch, so a queue forms. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 50,000 witnessed jobs, $3,000,000 in bonds locked 60 days, and 400 days waiting at the jetty. Like a harbor where every ship docks at the same pier, no ghost fleet slips in unseen. - Jowy
